```plato

    // Where each hole starts in that pool.
    HoleStarts(r: PolygonWithHoles2D): Array<Integer>
        => r.Holes.Count.MapRange(h => r.Boundary.Points.Count
            + h.Range.Reduce(0, (start, i) => start + r.Holes[i].Points.Count));
```
